explication: MASSCAN is an Internet-scale asynchronous IP/port scanner. The principal workflow is: a user supplies targets, ports, rate, and output options; configuration builds address/port ranges; the scan engine generates and throttles probes through the raw adapter; received packets are processed by the ad hoc IP/TCP stack and protocol/banner parsers; results are dispatched to selectable output formats. The tree and excerpts confirm orchestration, packet construction, TCP handling, configuration, parsing, and output components; some receive-side wiring is inferred only from documented responsibilities.
